name: patio-layout
js: (() => { const d = window.CITY.patioLayoutDump; if (!d) throw new Error('no CITY.patioLayoutDump: load the page with ?patios=layout'); const s = window.CITY.patioStats; console.log('[ride-check] patio-layout ' + JSON.stringify({ sites: d.sites.length, placed: s.placed, rejected: s.rejected, colliders: d.replay.colliders.length, furniture: d.replay.furniture.length, fingerprint: d.fingerprint, ms: s.ms, q: location.search })); return d; })()
